description: Outside full access every path hides every tool: the rules are replaced by 'everything' in ask and auto
old: EffRules(m) == IF m = "full" THEN {} ELSE denied
new: EffRules(m) == IF m = "full" THEN {} ELSE Tools

description: Full access empties the rules in ask and auto too: a denied tool is shown outside full access
old: EffRules(m) == IF m = "full" THEN {} ELSE denied

description: ask counts as full access: the rules are emptied in ask
old: EffRules(m) == IF m = "full" THEN {} ELSE denied
new: EffRules(m) == IF m # "auto" THEN {} ELSE denied

description: One path still reads the host's rules in full access: the bridge's call
old: RulesFor(p, m) == IF p \in OwnRules THEN denied ELSE EffRules(m)
new: RulesFor(p, m) == IF p \in OwnRules \/ p = "bridge_call" THEN denied ELSE EffRules(m)

description: The bridge is skipped: a denied tool runs through fx mcp call outside full access
old: Shown(p, a, t) == Access(a, t) /\ t \notin RulesFor(p, ModeOf(a)) /\ Gate(p, a, t)
new: Shown(p, a, t) == Access(a, t) /\ (t \notin RulesFor(p, ModeOf(a)) \/ p = "bridge_call") /\ Gate(p, a, t)

description: The integrations list is built from the host's rules in full access: a subagent's run of a denied tool is refused
Full access widens the access: a child limited to other servers is not limited
Search hides a tool no rule names in ask: one path gives another answer
old: Shown(p, a, t) == Access(a, t) /\ t \notin RulesFor(p, ModeOf(a)) /\ Gate(p, a, t)
new: Shown(p, a, t) == Access(a, t) /\ t \notin RulesFor(p, ModeOf(a)) /\ Gate(p, a, t) /\ ~(p = "search" /\ ModeOf(a) = "ask")

description: The host builds the integrations list with the host's mode, not the mode the child runs in
old: Gate(p, a, t) == IF a = "child" /\ p = "run" THEN t \in Integrations(childMode) ELSE TRUE
new: Gate(p, a, t) == IF a = "child" /\ p = "run" THEN t \in Integrations(mode) ELSE TRUE
